notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least one artifact and/or enchantment.
description:
Cast Ghalta by paying {5}{G}{G}{G}.
When Ghalta enters the battlefield, it, Cadric and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Dockside Extortionist to your hand if its on the battlefield, or returning nothing to your hand otherwise.
Resolve the Ghalta trigger, putting Dockside Extortionist onto the battlefield from your hand.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Dockside Extortionist trigger, creating at least one Treasure artifact token.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Ghalta to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the Cadric trigger from step 2, causing you to pay {1} to create a token copy of Ghalta with haste.
When the Ghalta token enters the battlefield, it and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning nothing to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the Ghalta token's trigger, putting Ghalta onto the battlefield from your hand.
Repeat from step 2.
If opponents control at least two artifacts and/or enchantments, this combo nets infinite Treasure tokens and colored mana.
